arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('main.py').read()
# remove unused names / tighten
src = src.replace("""ALL_TYPES = frozenset(('TIME', 'SIZE', 'COUNT', 'ID', 'FLAG'))\n""", "")
src = src.replace("""def is_int(v):
    return type(v) is int


""", "")
# docstring for module header
src = src.replace('''"""Offline finite-domain rule mining service.

Reads one JSON request on stdin, writes one JSON response on stdout.
"""''', '''"""Offline finite-domain rule mining service (NetNomos-inspired subsystem).

Reads one JSON request from stdin, writes one JSON response to stdout and
exits 0.  See the interface contract for the request/response profile and the
error precedence E_LIMIT > E_JSON > E_SCHEMA.
"""''')
open('main.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cd /app/submission && grep -n "isfinite\|import" main.py | head -12; python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/app/submission/main.py').read())" && echo "syntax ok"
cd /app/submission && python3 -m py_compile main.py && echo compiled; find /app/submission -name "__pycache__" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; ls -la /app/submission
